utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard they're still looking for volunteers, but I can swing by after errands and tell you what I find.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. Keep it simple and let me know what you find.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep it brief and check back once I’ve got something concrete.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks. I’ll bring the drill and the spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, I’ll grab the rest.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yeah, but I’m worried we’re cutting it close with the timing and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but are you sure we have everything we need before we head out?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I meant to check on that earlier, but I got distracted. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: If you can gather the tools and check the list by the shed, I’ll sort what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll grab the tools and check the list by the shed now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you tell me what needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think the gate latch and one of the porch steps need fixing, but I might be missing something.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks. I’ll just make sure we’re only planning for the latch and the porch step unless you remember anything else.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m here now. What do you need me to take care of for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ve got a couple of shelf brackets and a loose hinge you can start with, and if there’s time, check the porch light too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, I’ll start with the brackets and hinge, then check the porch light if I have time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus. I’m happy to help out with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Sam. I’ll bring the tools and we’ll get this repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Gus. Let’s get started and see what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on the repair drive location. Where did Faye say we should meet?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We said to meet by the school gym entrance after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it - I’ll meet you by the school gym entrance after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s picking up a bit more steam now. I heard a few neighbors already signed up, so it’s worth checking in soon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Definitely worth it, Tess. I’ll check in and spread the word to a few more neighbors today.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, I’m glad to hear it. I’ll keep spreading the word too, and hopefully we’ll get a few more folks signed up soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Rey, what time does the repair drive start, and do you still need help with anything?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It starts at 10. I’m fine for now, but I may need help moving the heavier boxes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can help with the heavier boxes at 10.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll come by for the repair drive and keep Nell posted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, keep me posted.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do, I’ll keep Nell posted.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Uli — I’ve got the repair drive list in order, and I’ll make sure we cover the most urgent fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Uli. I’ll keep you posted on the priority fixes, and your help will make a real difference.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are still dropping off supplies at the hall this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good to know. I’ll stop by the hall after lunch and see what still needs moving.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, thanks. I’ll swing by after lunch too and see if they need another hand.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Mostly just the trim and hinges left. I can walk you through it right now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, walk me through the trim first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I heard about the repair drive. What do you need me to know?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I just need help with the repairs, and I'd appreciate it if you could keep it quiet.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course. I’ll keep it quiet and just help with the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I just need you to pick up the spare parts from my porch and bring them to the repair drive. I’ve got the rest sorted.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can grab them and head over now.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules. Before we start, can you confirm what part of the repair drive you’re handling?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m handling the electrical fixes and the front porch latch.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive. I think I missed the latest update, but I can check what I was supposed to do.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, I can resend it. Just check the repair drive update and let me know what you were assigned.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, I’ll check the update and tell you what I was assigned.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s moving along, but I haven’t got the latest yet.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it’s still moving. I can check with the folks organizing it and let you know what they need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks. Keep me posted if they need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that repair drive, Leo. Tell me what needs fixing and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure. I need the drive itself and a quick check of the cables.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it. I’ll check the drive and the cables, then let you know if anything needs replacing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m worried about the timing and who’s handling the transport. If we don’t pin that down, the repair drive could turn into a mess.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Who’s driving, and what time do you need it handled by?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s get one driver confirmed and a firm time window first, or we’ll end up scrambling.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word now, Cleo, so if you want in on the repair drive, I can make sure you’re on the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Count me in, Quinn. Put me on the list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ve got you down, Cleo. I’ll send the invite along and make sure you get the details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after school pickup, but I need to make sure it fits around the repair drive schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That helps, thanks. I’ll keep the repair drive schedule in mind and we can work around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, just let me know the repair drive timing and I’ll fit pickup around it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell, I’ve got the repair drive list ready and I’m checking what we still need. Once you send me the latest updates, I’ll slot them in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa. I’ve only heard a few second-hand bits, but I’ll pass along anything new as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No rush, Nell. Just send me whatever you hear, and I’ll keep the list updated.
